THE SYNTHETIC INSURANCE TEST ACT (NOT REAL LAW - TEST FIXTURE)

PART I - PRELIMINARY

1. Short title.
This Act may be cited as the Synthetic Insurance Test Act.

2. Interpretation.
(1) In this Act, "insurer" means a company licensed to underwrite policies of insurance.
(2) "claimant" means a person who makes a claim under a policy.

PART II - CLAIMS

5. Notice of claim.
(1) A claimant shall give notice of a claim to the insurer within thirty days of the loss.
(2) An insurer shall not repudiate a claim solely because notice was given late, unless it was prejudiced.

6. Payment of claims.
An insurer shall pay a settled claim within ninety days of settlement.

7. Exclusions must be disclosed.
An insurer shall not rely on an exclusion unless it was disclosed to the insured in plain language before the policy began.
